scripts.build: npm --workspace @evicraft/runtime-sdk run build && tsc -b packages/server-host apps/agent packages/benchmark apps/cli tasks
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @evicraft/runtime-sdk run typecheck && tsc -b packages/server-host apps/agent packages/benchmark apps/cli tasks --pretty false && tsc -p apps/agent/tsconfig.type-tests.json --pretty false
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build && node apps/agent/dist/smoke/cli.js smoke
scripts.test:conformance: npm run build && node apps/agent/dist/smoke/cli.js conformance
scripts.clean: node --input-type=module --eval "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const path of ['packages/server-host/dist', 'apps/agent/dist', 'apps/cli/dist', 'packages/benchmark/dist', 'build/tasks', 'runtime/sdk/typescript/dist', 'runtime/sdk/typescript/.tsbuildinfo']) rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true });"
